title: Add explicit OpenSearch support
author: gregbaker
body_preview: I know it's possible to use `Elasticsearch7SearchEngine` with OpenSearch, but (1) it requires the older Python driver `"elasticsearch>=7.0.0,<7.14.0"` because the driver was deliberately poisoned so it wouldn't work with OpenSearch, and (2) it's probably not clear to potential users that Haystack would actually work with OpenSearch as it is.
